title.value: The generalizability of pre-processing techniques on the accuracy and fairness of data-driven building models: A case study
title.justification: The paper focuses on evaluating pre-processing techniques for data-driven building models, emphasizing accuracy and fairness.
title.quote: The generalizability of pre-processing techniques on the accuracy and fairness of data-driven building models: A case study

extractions.description: The paper investigates the application of different pre-processing techniques on data-driven building models, specifically looking at their impact on accuracy and fairness in predicting lighting status in apartments.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The study revolves around using data-driven models in buildings to predict energy-related outcomes, which contributes to energy efficiency, a core aspect of sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In recent years, buildings and building construction sectors have become data rich, due to the rapidly popularity of Internet of Things (IoT) and building management systems (BMS).

primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on improving predictive models for building energy efficiency directly supports climate change mitigation.
primary_category.quote: These data could be used as a basis to develop data-driven building models (DDBMs) to predict indoor air temperature, energy consumption, thermal comfort...

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not explicitly address other categories beyond climate change mitigation through energy efficiency in buildings.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper discusses data-driven building models that predict lighting, which is a component of energy efficiency strategies in buildings.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...developing 4 types of classifiers for one-week ahead lighting status prediction of 155 lights in 16 apartments through a year.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No additional sub-category is evidently covered in the paper aside from energy efficiency in buildings.

applications.value: Predictive modeling for building energy efficiency
applications.justification: The study’s application of pre-processing techniques to improve lighting prediction models targets energy efficiency in buildings.
applications.quote: The newly proposed SBS shows comparable performance to RPS. They significantly improve predictive accuracy for minority classes but decrease the accuracy for majority classes.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper fits within an existing category related to energy efficiency in buildings.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's content aligns with existing sub-category, 'Energy Efficiency in Buildings'.
